# Kitchen sink

Plain text with **bold**, *italic*, ***both***, ~~strike~~, `inline code`, <u>underline</u>,
H<sub>2</sub>O, x<sup>2</sup> and <mark>highlight</mark>.

Escapes stay literal: \*not italic\*, snake_case_word, 5 < 6, R&D and a backslash \\.
Two trailing spaces break  
and so does a backslash\
and a tag<br>too.
